note: Authored governing specifications for the process-guidance COMPONENTS inside a custom-pleading track — the records-and-attachment checklist and the filing instructions. The specification generator emits guidance specs for a guidance TRACK and for the guidance UNITS of a composed route, and a guidance component of a custom-pleading track matched neither shape, so every such component was reported as having no governing specification and blocked its whole track. The gate is closed by drafting the specifications, not by emitting an empty one: a track whose checklist and instructions nobody has written stays blocked, which is why only the five Tranche 1 tracks appear here.
appliesTo: Only the components listed. No other track is affected.
